news.q: The FAA expects its busiest Thanksgiving travel week in 16 years. To the nearest thousand, how many flights does it forecast over the nine-day holiday period?
news.fact: Tuesday, Nov. 24, was forecast to be the busiest day, with more than 52,000 flights.

news.q: Karl-Anthony Towns kept his season-opening double-double streak alive as the Knicks beat the Cavaliers 121-102 on Nov. 25. How many games in a row is it now?
news.fact: The win was New York's sixth straight.

easy.q: How many thieves pull off the casino heist in the 2001 movie Ocean's Eleven?
easy.fact: George Clooney plays ringleader Danny Ocean.

easy.q: Lincoln's Gettysburg Address opens with "Four score and seven years ago." How many years is that?
easy.fact: A score is 20, so he was counting back to 1776.

easy.q: How many U.S. states share a border with Mexico?
easy.fact: They are California, Arizona, New Mexico and Texas.

easy.q: The Summer Olympics are normally held once every how many years?
easy.fact: Tokyo's 2020 Games were the rare exception, pushed back a year.

easy.q: How many small squares make up a standard Sudoku grid?
easy.fact: The grid is nine rows by nine columns.

medium.q: What's the most players allowed in one game of the hit video game Among Us?
medium.fact: The limit rose from 10 to 15 in a December 2020 update.

medium.q: How many debates did Abraham Lincoln and Stephen Douglas hold in their 1858 Illinois Senate race?
medium.fact: Douglas won the Senate seat, but Lincoln won the presidency two years later.

medium.q: How many countries make up Central America?
medium.fact: Belize is the only one where English is the official language.

medium.q: How many feet long is a regulation tennis court?
medium.fact: Singles and doubles courts are the same length; doubles is just wider.

medium.q: In what year did Apple release the first iPod?
medium.fact: Apple pitched it as "1,000 songs in your pocket."

hard.q: To the nearest hundred feet, how deep is Hells Canyon on the Idaho–Oregon line, North America's deepest river gorge?
hard.fact: It's deeper than the Grand Canyon, carved by the Snake River.

hard.q: China's Ming dynasty ruled from 1368 to 1644. How many years is that?
hard.fact: Much of the Great Wall you can visit today was built under the Ming.

hard.q: Before LeBron James passed him in 2023, how many career points did Kareem Abdul-Jabbar score, the NBA record?
hard.fact: He held the record for nearly 39 years.

hard.q: How many weeks did Mark Ronson and Bruno Mars's "Uptown Funk!" spend at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: It was the top song of 2015 on Billboard's year-end chart.
